ambient: The voice announces something for later.
A gap opens. It is comfortable, and it goes on slightly too long.
A theme starts, ten seconds of it, and is faded under.
description: Small hours, and a continuity voice is reading out the schedule for a day that is not going to happen. It is doing it warmly and without hurrying. Between the items there is a great deal of nothing, and the nothing is the part that was prepared.
name: The Overnight

looks: Warm, unhurried, and reading from something.
It gives a time, and the time is not one that comes around.
It is talking to you the way a voice talks to a room it assumes is empty.
objects.name: the voice

looks: Every slot filled. None of the titles hold still long enough to be read.
Between the items there is a gap, and the gap is longer each time.
You are on it, somewhere in the small hours, for four minutes.
objects.name: the schedule

weather: The forecast is read out, at length, for a region that is never named.
